description: This Java source file defines the JmsServiceEngine class, which extends AbstractEngine and manages JMS messaging operations such as sending messages to topics and queues, including support for XA transactions. It includes methods for creating messages, handling JNDI lookups, and executing messaging based on server configurations.

classes.name: JmsServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that manages JMS messaging operations, including sending messages to topics and queues, with support for transactional messaging and configuration-based server selection.

methods.name: getServiceElement
methods.description: Retrieves the JmsService configuration element based on the model service.

methods.name: makeMessage
methods.description: Creates a JMS MapMessage with serialized service context, ensuring no required OUT parameters are present.

methods.name: serverList
methods.description: Determines the list of server configurations based on the send mode attribute.

methods.name: runTopic
methods.description: Publishes a message to a JMS topic using JNDI lookup and connection factory.

methods.name: runQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS queue using JNDI lookup and connection factory.

methods.name: runXaQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS queue with XA transaction support, enlisting resources if a transaction is active.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes messaging operations across configured servers, dispatching to topic or queue methods.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs messaging operations ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs messaging operations asynchronously and sends the result to a requester.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs messaging operations asynchronously without a requester.
